entities.summary: Dustin Michael Tokarski is a Canadian professional ice hockey goaltender for Olimpija Ljubljana of the ICE Hockey League (ICEHL). He was born in Humboldt, Saskatchewan, but grew up in neighbouring Watson, which he considers his hometown.
